method: L2 gas = testnet 46630 raw receipt gasUsed - gasUsedForL1 (testnet L1 price is ~0, so the testnet L1 part reads 0); mainnet L1 gas = NodeInterface(0xC8).gasEstimateL1Component on 4663 for the same tx input — a single sample of today's L1 price, stress-tested at 10x below; everything priced at 2x eth_gasPrice(4663)
notes: The three testnet deploys predate two small edits (Results constructor reads Scrimmage.GENESIS; Scrimmage writes paidInSeason before the WIF calls); the deploy-gas delta is under 1% and does not touch the post or relay rows.
40 relayed commits is the minimum the budget must carry; the relayer runs with a daily ETH stop, and further relays draw on the remainder.

notOperatorCost.WIF.approve + Scrimmage.pay: signed and paid by the player
notOperatorCost.contract verification: Blockscout source verification is off chain (no gas)
notOperatorCost.SemalamPaymaster deploy + deposit + smar: Tier 2 only; funded from the remainder if built
